assign.outcome:
**Condition (2) is true — the save path closes for the first time in six audits. Condition (3) is still false, on the same defect, one level deeper again.**

**My exit condition, unchanged since visit five.** (1) exactly one class draws a configured page; (2) the words a control writes are the words the file stores are the words the url says are the words the reader reads, and every one of the seven can be **set, saved and sent** by the same reader; (3) no control writes a key nothing reads, and no renderer reads a key nothing writes — *on every page, including the pages the realm makes*. **(1) and (2) are true now. (3) is not.**

**Six of my seven landed; the seventh half-landed.** A nested made page draws its own children (`stage.js:72` `stage_props()`, one translation, both callers), blocks and the content word compose, the dead renderer is gone, Build's step 3 says *Content colour*, the drawer's actions are `.paging-act`. The docs item is the half: three files were rewritten, three others were not.

**Renderers: one, and for the first time nothing dead beside it.** `stage.js:133 PagingStage`, five callers, and a grep for the stage's own markup finds it in no other file. **Vocabularies: one**, and `PIECES` — which I charged last visit — stopped costing anything the moment blocks and content began to compose.

**The save path, measured end to end.** On `/imagine/paging/make/notes/` the bar has seven selects labelled in the reader's own words. I set **room** and **type size**: `made/notes/page.json` said `wide`/`display` within the second, **the address stayed bare** (saving moves the page's own words first), and a bare reload came back with both, all seven dropdowns set. Sending still works separately — `?room=narrow` opens narrow and writes nothing. Build's middle wears the same bar and its left column follows it in one press. **`content` takes a url both ways**, the address carries it, and the **loop fuse holds**: I saved a page's `content` as its own address — the two-click loop the code warns about — and a cold reload drew two levels then stopped with a link. **130 cold loads at 1280 and 3440, zero page errors, zero sideways scroll.** Every file I touched is restored; `public/imagine/paging` is clean.

![The page has a whole page running inside its box — and the drawer's two exports, 'This page, as a file' and 'The same page, as code', both carry the seven words and no nest](shots/nest-not-saved-1280.png)

**Look at the drawer.** The first box on that rail hands you `…?nest=dashboard` — the nested page is real and sendable. Two boxes lower, *This page, as a file* and *The same page, as code* both print the seven words and **no nest**, and nothing says so. The owner's own sentence — *"put any one of these page types inside any other"* — is the one thing neither export carries. Meanwhile its savable twin already exists: `content` takes a url and **is** written to the file. **Two controls, one idea, one of them saveable.**

**And the third break is the smallest and the oldest shape.** Build's star writes `mode.default` onto a child, the file keeps it, the **builder's preview** opens that tab — and the saved page never reads it (`stage_props()` returns `pages` and `draw`, no `open`). The printed `page.js` even emits the bare comment `// the tab that opens first` with no code under it. Proven in the running app against a synthetic node, with no file written. That is the seven words, then the blocks, then a nested page's children, and now the eighth field: **five rounds, the same defect, one level in each time.**

**Seven items, ranked, in the `log` lines below** — two M, five S. Nothing cosmetic above item 5.

log.msg: FIX 1 - The nested page has to survive being saved - config.js:317 node_for() and config.js:295 code_for_config() print the seven words and drop stage.nest, on the same rail whose first box hands you ?nest=dashboard. Either carry it (nest into mode, blocks.js:295 EXTRAS, read back in stage.js) or retire the control in favour of content=<url>, which already saves - but two controls for one idea, one of them lossy, is the realm's own oldest complaint. Ask the owner which; the carrying version is the smaller change - M

FIX 2 - The default tab is read by the builder's preview and by nothing on the saved page - build/words.js:181 set_default writes mode.default, build/stage.js:54 reads it, and stage.js:72 stage_props() returns {pages, draw} with no open, so stage.js:164 leaves open null on every page you made. One line in stage_props (open: kids.findIndex(is_default)), and the same line closes build/words.js:242, which today prints the comment `// the tab that opens first` with no code under it - S

FIX 3 - The two url controls accept different pages - ?nest=/imagine/paging/library/blog-post/ runs that preset (url.js:125 resolves a library url to its seven words) and ?content= the same url says `There is no page or file at ...`, which is false and is one of the twelve pages the rail links. stage.js:422 page_at() should ask nest_of() first, so eleven ready-made pages stop being nestable-but-not-contentable through two fields that look identical - S

FIX 4 - Build now has TWO controls for three of its seven words - build/page.js:188/190/192 (steps 2, 3, 4: navigation, content colour, arrangement) sit beside build/page.js:404, the realm's own seven-select bar, on one screen. They stay in sync, so this is not a bug - it is the realm's `one name, one control` rule broken by the fix that made all seven savable. Let the bar own the seven words and leave the left column the four things it alone can say: Name, Blocks, Pages, Code - S

FIX 6 - Twelve chips in the drawer announce nothing - config.js:159, the nest chips, carry role=button and tabindex but no aria-pressed, while the 39 chips in the form above them (config.js:132) all do; MEASURED, 12 of 51 chips in the rail, and one of the twelve is the lit one.
